en.text: For, behold, the Lord, GOD of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support, the whole supply of bread, and the whole supply of water;

footnotes.text: 3:1 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה*”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.
3:1 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

zhSimplified.text: 主—万军之耶和华从耶路撒冷和犹大， 除掉众人所倚靠的，所仗赖的， 就是所倚靠的粮，所仗赖的水；

zhTraditional.text: 主－萬軍之耶和華從耶路撒冷和猶大， 除掉眾人所倚靠的，所仗賴的， 就是所倚靠的糧，所仗賴的水；

en.text: the mighty man, the man of war, the judge, the prophet, the diviner, the elder,

zhSimplified.text: 除掉勇士和战士， 审判官和先知， 占卜的和长老，

zhTraditional.text: 除掉勇士和戰士， 審判官和先知， 占卜的和長老，

en.text: the captain of fifty, the honorable man, the counselor, the skilled craftsman, and the clever enchanter.

zhSimplified.text: 五十夫长和尊贵人， 谋士和有巧艺的， 以及妙行法术的。

zhTraditional.text: 五十夫長和尊貴人， 謀士和有巧藝的， 以及妙行法術的。

en.text: I will give boys to be their princes, and children shall rule over them.

zhSimplified.text: 主说：我必使孩童作他们的首领， 使婴孩辖管他们。

zhTraditional.text: 主說：我必使孩童作他們的首領， 使嬰孩轄管他們。

en.text: The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly against the old man, and the wicked against the honorable.

zhSimplified.text: 百姓要彼此欺压； 各人受邻舍的欺压。 少年人必侮慢老年人； 卑贱人必侮慢尊贵人。

zhTraditional.text: 百姓要彼此欺壓； 各人受鄰舍的欺壓。 少年人必侮慢老年人； 卑賤人必侮慢尊貴人。

en.text: Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying, “You have clothing, you be our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand.”

zhSimplified.text: 人在父家拉住弟兄，说： 你有衣服，可以作我们的官长。 这败落的事归在你手下吧！

zhTraditional.text: 人在父家拉住弟兄，說： 你有衣服，可以作我們的官長。 這敗落的事歸在你手下吧！

en.text: In that day he will cry out, saying, “I will not be a healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing. You shall not make me ruler of the people.”

zhSimplified.text: 那时，他必扬声说： 我不作医治你们的人； 因我家中没有粮食，也没有衣服， 你们不可立我作百姓的官长。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，他必揚聲說： 我不作醫治你們的人； 因我家中沒有糧食，也沒有衣服， 你們不可立我作百姓的官長。

en.text: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen; because their tongue and their doings are against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of his glory.

footnotes.text: 3:8 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

zhSimplified.text: 耶路撒冷败落， 犹大倾倒； 因为他们的舌头和行为与耶和华反对， 惹了他荣光的眼目。

zhTraditional.text: 耶路撒冷敗落， 猶大傾倒； 因為他們的舌頭和行為與耶和華反對， 惹了他榮光的眼目。

en.text: The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul! For they have brought disaster upon themselves.

zhSimplified.text: 他们的面色证明自己的不正； 他们述说自己的罪恶，并不隐瞒， 好像所多玛一样。 他们有祸了！因为作恶自害。

zhTraditional.text: 他們的面色證明自己的不正； 他們述說自己的罪惡，並不隱瞞， 好像所多瑪一樣。 他們有禍了！因為作惡自害。

en.text: Tell the righteous that it will be well with them, for they will eat the fruit of their deeds.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要论义人说：他必享福乐， 因为要吃自己行为所结的果子。

zhTraditional.text: 你們要論義人說：他必享福樂， 因為要吃自己行為所結的果子。

en.text: Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them, for the deeds of their hands will be paid back to them.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人有祸了！他必遭灾难！ 因为要照自己手所行的受报应。

zhTraditional.text: 惡人有禍了！他必遭災難！ 因為要照自己手所行的受報應。

en.text: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. My people, those who lead you cause you to err, and destroy the way of your paths.

zhSimplified.text: 至于我的百姓， 孩童欺压他们， 妇女辖管他们。 我的百姓啊，引导你的使你走错， 并毁坏你所行的道路。

zhTraditional.text: 至於我的百姓， 孩童欺壓他們， 婦女轄管他們。 我的百姓啊，引導你的使你走錯， 並毀壞你所行的道路。

en.text: The LORD stands up to contend, and stands to judge the peoples.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华起来辩论， 站着审判众民。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華起來辯論， 站着審判眾民。

en.text: The LORD will enter into judgment with the elders of his people and their leaders: “It is you who have eaten up the vineyard. The plunder of the poor is in your houses.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华必审问他民中的长老和首领，说： 吃尽葡萄园果子的就是你们； 向贫穷人所夺的都在你们家中。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華必審問他民中的長老和首領，說： 吃盡葡萄園果子的就是你們； 向貧窮人所奪的都在你們家中。

en.text: What do you mean that you crush my people, and grind the face of the poor?” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.

footnotes.text: 3:15 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

zhSimplified.text: 主—万军之耶和华说： 你们为何压制我的百姓， 搓磨贫穷人的脸呢？

zhTraditional.text: 主－萬軍之耶和華說： 你們為何壓制我的百姓， 搓磨貧窮人的臉呢？

en.text: Moreover the LORD said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes, walking daintily as they go, jingling ornaments on their feet;

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华又说： 因为锡安的女子狂傲， 行走挺项，卖弄眼目， 俏步徐行，脚下玎珰，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華又說： 因為錫安的女子狂傲， 行走挺項，賣弄眼目， 俏步徐行，腳下玎璫，

en.text: therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion, and the LORD will make their scalps bald.”

zhSimplified.text: 所以，主必使锡安的女子头长秃疮； 耶和华又使她们赤露下体。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，主必使錫安的女子頭長禿瘡； 耶和華又使她們赤露下體。

en.text: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, the headbands, the crescent necklaces,

zhSimplified.text: 到那日，主必除掉她们华美的脚钏、发网、月牙圈、

zhTraditional.text: 到那日，主必除掉她們華美的腳釧、髮網、月牙圈、

en.text: the earrings, the bracelets, the veils,

zhSimplified.text: 耳环、手镯、蒙脸的帕子、

zhTraditional.text: 耳環、手鐲、蒙臉的帕子、

en.text: the headdresses, the ankle chains, the sashes, the perfume containers, the charms,

zhSimplified.text: 华冠、足链、华带、香盒、符囊、

zhTraditional.text: 華冠、足鍊、華帶、香盒、符囊、

en.text: the signet rings, the nose rings,

zhSimplified.text: 戒指、鼻环、

zhTraditional.text: 戒指、鼻環、

en.text: the fine robes, the capes, the cloaks, the purses,

zhSimplified.text: 吉服、外套、云肩、荷包、

zhTraditional.text: 吉服、外套、雲肩、荷包、

en.text: the hand mirrors, the fine linen garments, the tiaras, and the shawls.

zhSimplified.text: 手镜、细麻衣、裹头巾、蒙身的帕子。

zhTraditional.text: 手鏡、細麻衣、裹頭巾、蒙身的帕子。

en.text: It shall happen that instead of sweet spices, there shall be rottenness; instead of a belt, a rope; instead of well set hair, baldness; instead of a robe, a wearing of sackcloth; and branding instead of beauty.

zhSimplified.text: 必有臭烂代替馨香， 绳子代替腰带， 光秃代替美发， 麻衣系腰代替华服， 烙伤代替美容。

zhTraditional.text: 必有臭爛代替馨香， 繩子代替腰帶， 光禿代替美髮， 麻衣繫腰代替華服， 烙傷代替美容。

en.text: Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.

zhSimplified.text: 你的男丁必倒在刀下； 你的勇士必死在阵上。

zhTraditional.text: 你的男丁必倒在刀下； 你的勇士必死在陣上。

en.text: Her gates shall lament and mourn. She shall be desolate and sit on the ground.

zhSimplified.text: 锡安的城门必悲伤、哀号； 她必荒凉坐在地上。

zhTraditional.text: 錫安的城門必悲傷、哀號； 她必荒涼坐在地上。
